title: Understanding the Update Rule
text:
The update rule for logistic regression with L2 regularization is given by:

$${	heta}^{t+1}$$ $$=$$ (1-2λ)θ**(t) + \alpha[(y_i - σ(X_i * θ**(t))) * X_i]

Here, σ(z) is the sigmoid function, which is defined as:

σ(z) $$=$$ $$1$$ / (1 + e**(-z))

This function outputs a value between $$0$$ and $$1$$, representing the probability that the output is $$1$$.

title: Calculate the Sigmoid Function
text:
Given $${	heta}^t$$ $$=$$ $$-1$$ and $$X_i$$ $$=$$ $$5$$, calculate the value of the sigmoid function σ(X_i * θ**(t)).

σ(X_i * θ**(t)) $$=$$ $$1$$ / (1 + e**(-X_i * θ**(t)))

Substitute the given values to find σ.

title: Calculate σ(X_i * θ**(t))
text:
Substitute $${	heta}^t$$ $$=$$ $$-1$$ and $$X_i$$ $$=$$ $$5$$ into the sigmoid function:

σ(5 * -1) $$=$$ $$1$$ / (1 + e**(5))

Calculate the value of σ.

title: Determine the Impact of $$y_i$$
text: The term (y_i - σ(X_i * θ**(t))) in the update rule affects the direction and magnitude of the update. Consider how different values of $$y_i$$ (0 or 1) will impact this term.

title: Compare the Updates
text: Compare the calculated values of $${\theta}^{t+1}$$ for $$y_i$$ $$=$$ $$1$$ and $$y_i$$ $$=$$ $$0$$. Determine which value is more positive, considering the effect of λ.

title: Final Decision
text: Based on the calculations, which value of $$y_i$$ results in the most positive $${\theta}^{t+1}$$? Consider the impact of λ and whether it affects the decision.
